concerns.text: The plan proposes to *optionally augment* the curated metallic‑glass CSV with composition‑only entries from the Materials Project and AFLOWlib APIs (see “ingest a curated literature CSV … optionally augment it with composition‑only entries from the Materials Project (MP) and AFLOWlib APIs”). These external sources do **not** provide measured CTE values, so the added rows will be dropped during the “exclude rows with missing `cte`” step. Consequently, they cannot increase the usable sample size and the coverage metric (`retrieved_entries / csv_entries`) becomes misleading. FR‑001 explicitly requires ≥ 95 % coverage of the curated dataset **and** ≥ 500 usable entries with CTE values; the current approach does not guarantee either and effectively treats a failure to meet the target as acceptable, violating the functional requirement.
